mostWorthwhile.text: Driving the shock through the burning shells was most worthwhile: it connected the star’s interior to the dispersal of its elements.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final combination with open space felt somewhat repetitive after the explosion had already thrown material outward.

surprise.text: I was struck that electrons and protons combine into neutrons during collapse, and that a more massive remnant might instead become a black hole.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to turn an exploding star into expanding ejecta felt more like a required confirmation than a distinct physical step.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the scattered elements into later worlds, especially given the clear explanations and qualifications about the explosion.
